changeSet.author: proxima
changeSet.comment: Migrate all timestamp columns to TIMESTAMPTZ for global timezone support
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE jobs ALTER COLUMN posted_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING posted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE jobs ALTER COLUMN expires_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING expires_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE jobs ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE jobs ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_runs ALTER COLUMN started_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_runs ALTER COLUMN completed_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_runs ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_runs ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE job_views ALTER COLUMN viewed_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING viewed_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE job_views ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE job_views ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_configs ALTER COLUMN last_run_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING last_run_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_configs ALTER COLUMN last_success_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING last_success_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_configs ALTER COLUMN last_error_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING last_error_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_configs ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE scraper_configs ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE companies ALTER COLUMN last_scraped_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING last_scraped_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE companies ALTER COLUMN created_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
ALTER TABLE companies ALTER COLUMN updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMPTZ USING updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
